description: This file defines the VersionAttribute class used to specify version numbers for interfaces in Orleans, including metadata and a method to populate interface properties.

classes.name: VersionAttribute
classes.description: A sealed attribute class used to assign version numbers to interfaces in Orleans, implementing IGrainInterfacePropertiesProviderAttribute.

methods.name: VersionAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the version number for the attribute.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Method to populate the properties dictionary with the version information for the interface.
